page_summary: This section discusses the importance of national governance in enhancing port cybersecurity resilience. It highlights the role of national legislation and policy frameworks in establishing responsibilities and expectations for cybersecurity across various stakeholders in the port ecosystem. The text emphasizes the need for coordinated national cybersecurity strategies that align with broader socio-economic objectives. It also introduces a table that synthesizes core elements of national cybersecurity governance frameworks into five themes: governance and accountability, risk prevention and protection, reporting and information-sharing, resilience and continuity, and enforcement and oversight.
